Additional information, per the preliminary datasheet (subject to change, I suppose...), follows... *The device is using QCA9880 version 2. *Operating voltage: 3.3 VDC, 5 VDC *Power consumption: 7 W *Antenna connectors: 3x MMCX *RoHS compliant
